title: 第二十五章 消灭(改过)
content_zh:
被消灭的就应该消失，是吗？

    还是应该消失的，就应该被消灭？

    其实，没有应该消失的，也没有应该被消灭的，只是立场不同，敌人与朋友，有时候站在不同的立场上，是会变成对方的。

    就像人类与吸血鬼。

    A区中，艾妮尔的房间里，萨尔的手臂已经完全恢复如初，艾勒维格他们三人只等着对方告诉他们，他们不在时到底发生了什么，为什么水怪会进入这里袭击萨尔，为什么艾妮尔不见了，她又去了哪里。

    可是萨尔却迟迟不开口，除了沉默还是沉默。

    多力看看艾勒维格，再看看尼克，至于埃布尔就算了，因为他的存在与不存在根本没什么区别。可是那两位比较有存在感的此时也是一样，与萨尔一样的沉默，与埃布尔一样的不存在。

    “你们到底打算怎么做啊？艾妮尔呢？她去哪里了？被抓了？我们要不要去救她？你们到是出个声啊！”在无数次的挣扎之后，他还是鼓起勇气，冲着那几个谁都惹不起的家伙吼道。

    “多力！”艾勒维格突然抬起头了，带着坏坏的笑，“什么时候你这么关心艾妮尔了？”

    “我……”多力一愣，不自觉的转头望向一旁的萨尔，而对方也正看着他，四目相视，多力不由的浑身一颤，猛的收回了目光，疙疙瘩瘩的说，“我只是觉得就算艾妮尔是吸血鬼，很强大，那也是个女孩子啊！她现在生死不明的，我们几个大男人总不能干坐着，不闻不问吧！”

    “那你打算怎么问？”艾勒维格一边看戏，一边继续扇风，“再说，就算她有事也用不着你去担心吧！你跟她是什么关系啊！”

    “我……她……她是我们的首领，队长，她如果出了事，对我们……我们可没有好处，所以我……”多力自然是心里怎么想怎么说，可是面对艾勒维格那“真是如此”的疑问眼神时，还是禁不住咬到舌头。

    “你这么紧张干什么！我又没说你对我们的这位小队长有别的心思。”艾勒维格进一步退一步的逗多力玩着。

    “我……我……”弄得多力连最基本的说话都变得困难。

    “好了，现在说正事吧！”艾勒维格看着玩的差不多了，面色转而一正，说着站起身来到萨尔的面前，“艾妮尔肯定是要去救的，不过现在似乎不是跟他们闹翻的时候，所以我觉得还是由你出面找那个叫爱夏的女人比较好，我想艾妮尔的失踪多半跟她有关！”

    “你就不怕我跟她闹翻？”萨尔抬起头，双眼中的血色就跟冰冻了一样，透出森森的寒气，让正面的艾勒维格从心里打了个冷战。

    “可是现在只有这个办法可行。”艾勒维格本着自己的专长，肯定道。

    “好！”萨尔起身，没有犹豫，转身之际，“如果她伤了艾妮尔，那么已经不是闹翻的问题了。”

    “萨尔！”眨眼之间，萨尔消失了，多力急唤，可是对方早已经听不见，或者说不打算听见，艾勒维格笑笑，“好像越来越有趣了。”

    “你……”

    “我最大的爱好就是看戏！”艾勒维格毫不客气的承认道。

    “你……真是……真是……”多力气的无话可说，艾勒维格已经提步追萨尔去了，再怎么说看戏也得用看的啊！不身临其境，哪能享受到真正的乐趣！

    “好了，走吧！”尼克拍了下多力的臂膀，也起步跟上。

    “我！”多力突然发现，原来在他们的眼中，自己就跟一个小丑似的，当初在外面，在人类的社会中，他再怎么说也是一个武器专家，天天感受着的是别人羡慕的目光和赞许的话语，而现在呢？他竟然成了一个小丑，一个被他们在这种时候拿来消遣的玩偶！

    “别太难过，这才是人类！”结果最后埃布尔离开时，竟然给了他这么一句。

    “这是安慰？还是嘲笑？”多力有些分不清楚，因为在很大程度上，安慰与嘲笑不是通过字面，而是说话时的语气，但是这句话却来自一个没有任何语气的说话者，多力真是郁闷之极，最后重重的叹了口气，还是跟上了，谁让他的心好呢？

    萨尔一出房间，就直冲酒馆，因为除了爱夏自己送上门来，一般在那里才可以遇到她。可是此时的酒馆，在萨尔踏入的那一刻，声音不是没了，而是突然变大了，大的就像是尖叫声。

    不！这就是尖叫声！

    地上，墙上，桌子上，爬满了各色各样的虫子，形状有点像是水怪，可是跟水怪又有所区别，至少它们看起来没有水怪那么无害。

    “咝~咝~”有的虫子还不断的发出蛇吐信子的声音，吓的一旁的那几个人类尖叫不断。而另几个贵族围成一个圈，将人类护在中间，可是那些虫子越爬越近，似乎看到了大餐一般快下滴下口水。

    突然看到如此的场面，任谁都会觉得不舒服。

    “呃！这些是什么东西啊？虫子不像虫子的。”萨尔迟疑了片刻，艾勒维格他们也到了酒馆，多力探出脑袋一看，起了一身的鸡皮疙瘩，包着双臂后悔自己的好奇。

    “别进来！它们是变异生物！如果被它们缠上就麻烦了。”贵族中，那个胡子扯着粗嗓子冲萨尔他们大叫。

    “我们不进来，你们就麻烦了。”艾勒维格笑了笑，竟然一点也没有不适的感觉。

    “你打算怎么做？”尼克捏紧了手里的短刀，砍杀的兴奋感已经在心中慢慢的升起，众所周知的是，杀过一个人之后，你会继续杀人，原因么，那是一种何等的刺激与快感。

    “放把火把这里烧了！”艾勒维格慢慢腾腾的说道。

    “烧了？”尼克一愣。
content_en:
What is eliminated should disappear, right?
Or should it disappear and be eliminated?
In fact, nothing should disappear or be eliminated. It's just that the positions are different. Enemies and friends, sometimes standing on different positions, will become each other.
Like humans versus vampires.
In Area A, in Enel's room, Thrall's arm has completely recovered to its original state. Ellevig and the three of them are just waiting for each other to tell them what happened while they were away, why the water monster entered here to attack Sal, why Enel disappeared, and where she went.
But Sal didn't speak for a long time, and there was only silence.
Doli looked at Ellevig and then at Nick. As for Abel, forget it, because there was no difference between his existence and his non-existence.But the same thing happened to the two people who had more presence at this time. They were as silent as Sal and as non-existent as Abel.
"What are you going to do? Where is Enel? Where has she gone? Has she been caught? Should we rescue her? You should make a noise!" After countless struggles, he still mustered up the courage and shouted at those guys who could not afford to offend him.
"Dolly!" Ellevig suddenly raised his head with a wicked smile, "Since when have you cared so much about Enel?"
"I..." Doli was stunned, and unconsciously turned to look at Sal, who was also looking at him, looking at each other. Doli couldn't help but trembled, and suddenly looked away, and said with a lump, "I just think that even if Enel is a vampire and very powerful, she is still a girl! Her life and death are unknown now, and we grown men can't just sit here and ignore her!"
"Then what are you going to ask?" Ellevig continued to fan while watching the show, "Besides, even if something happens to her, there is no need for you to worry! What is your relationship with her?"
"I...she...she is our leader, captain. If something happens to her, it will be of no benefit to us...us, so I..." Doli naturally said whatever he thought in his heart, but when faced with Ellevig's questioning look of "really so", he couldn't help biting his tongue.
"Why are you so nervous! I didn't say you had other thoughts about our squad leader." Ellevig took a step back to tease Doli.
"I...I..." Doli found it difficult to even speak the most basic words.
"Okay, let's get down to business now!" Ellevig saw that the fun was almost over, his face straightened, and he stood up and came to Sal, "Enel must be rescued, but now doesn't seem to be the time to fall out with them, so I think it's better for you to come forward and find the woman named Aisha. I think Enel's disappearance is probably related to her!"
"Aren't you afraid that I'll fall out with her?" Sal raised his head, the blood in his eyes was as cold as ice, and the coldness in his eyes made Ellevig shiver in his heart.
"But this is the only feasible method now." Ellevig affirmed based on his expertise.
"Okay!" Sal stood up without hesitation and turned around, "If she hurt Enel, then it is no longer a matter of falling out."
"Sal!" In the blink of an eye, Sal disappeared. Duoli called out urgently, but the other party could no longer hear it, or said he didn't intend to hear it. Ellevig smiled, "It seems to be getting more and more interesting."
"you……"
"My biggest hobby is watching theater!" Ellevig admitted unceremoniously.
"You... are really... really..." I was so exhausted that I had nothing to say. Ellevig had already taken steps to chase Sal. No matter how much he said, he had to watch the show!How can you enjoy the real fun without being there!
"Okay, let's go!" Nick patted Duoli's arm and started to follow.
"Me!" Duoli suddenly discovered that in their eyes, he was just like a clown. Back then, in the human society, he was still a weapons expert. He felt the envious looks and words of approval from others every day. But now?He turned out to be a clown, a doll they used to entertain themselves at times like this!
"Don't be too sad, this is what humans are!" Abel actually said this to him when he left in the end.
"Is this comfort? Or is it ridicule?" Duoli couldn't tell the difference, because to a large extent, comfort and ridicule are not expressed in words, but in the tone of speaking. However, this sentence came from a speaker without any tone. Duoli was really depressed. He sighed heavily in the end and followed. Who made him feel good?
As soon as Sal left the room, he went straight to the tavern, because unless Aisha came to the door by herself, that's where you could usually meet her.But in the tavern at this time, the moment Sal stepped into it, the sound did not disappear, but suddenly became louder, as loud as a scream.
No!This is the scream!
The ground, walls, and tables were covered with all kinds of bugs. They looked a bit like water monsters, but they were different from them. At least they didn't look as harmless as water monsters.
“咝~咝~”有的虫子还不断的发出蛇吐信子的声音，吓的一旁的那几个人类尖叫不断。Several other nobles formed a circle to protect the humans in the middle, but the insects crawled closer and closer, drooling as if they had seen a big meal.
Anyone would feel uncomfortable seeing such a scene suddenly.
"Uh! What are these? Bugs don't look like bugs." Sal hesitated for a moment. Elleweg and the others also arrived at the tavern. Doli poked his head out to take a look, and got goosebumps all over his body. He wrapped his arms and regretted his curiosity.
"Don't come in! They are mutated creatures! If you get entangled with them, you will be in trouble." Among the nobles, the bearded one shouted at Thrall and the others in a rough voice.
"If we don't come in, you will be in trouble." Ellevig smiled, but he didn't feel any discomfort at all.
"What are you going to do?" Nick squeezed the dagger in his hand, and the excitement of slashing slowly rose in his heart. It is well known that after killing someone, you will continue to kill others. Why? What a thrill and pleasure it is.
"Set fire and burn this place down!" Ellevig said slowly.
"Burned?" Nick was stunned.
